kit.notifications.appDenied: Notifications for {app} are turned off in the phone’s settings.

kit.plan.changeInBrowser: This subscription was bought on the web: change or cancel it from {app} in a browser, in Settings › Plan.
kit.plan.store.app_store: Apple only lets you cancel it in its store. On your iPhone or iPad, open Settings › your name › Subscriptions › {app} › Cancel Subscription.

kit.plan.founderNote: Billed yearly. Your price stays as long as you stay subscribed.

kit.data.eraseHint: Everything you have in {app} goes, and your account stays. What others share with you is left alone.

kit.data.eraseKeeps: Only your data is deleted: your account stays active.

kit.data.eraseKeepsBelow: Only your data is deleted: your account stays active. To delete the account too, use “{section}”, further down in this section.

kit.data.deleteHint.one: If you delete your account, it is switched off for {n} day and then deleted automatically, with everything you have in {app}. If you change your mind before then, sign in and you can take it back as it was.
kit.data.deleteHint.other: If you delete your account, it is switched off for {n} days and then deleted automatically, with everything you have in {app}. If you change your mind before then, sign in and you can take it back as it was.

kit.data.deleteShared: What you share with other people stays with them, unless you stop sharing it before deleting your account.

kit.data.deleteText.one: You will be signed out on every device and your AI connections will stop working. In {n} day your account and everything you have in {app} will be deleted, with no way back.
kit.data.deleteText.other: You will be signed out on every device and your AI connections will stop working. In {n} days your account and everything you have in {app} will be deleted, with no way back.

kit.data.deleteBilling: If you have a subscription, it stops renewing.
kit.data.identityUsed: You also use your account in {apps}.
kit.data.identityUnknown: You may also use your account in other apps, but we can’t check right now.
kit.data.identityGoesUnknown: Also delete my access to the other apps
kit.data.identityHint: Unticked, only {app} is deleted and you keep signing in to {apps} with your account. Ticked, you also lose access to {apps}: if you want to delete what you have there or cancel a subscription, do it first in {apps}.
kit.data.identityHintUnknown: Unticked, only {app} is deleted and your account still works in the other apps. Ticked, you lose access to all of them: if you want to delete what you have in them or cancel a subscription, do it first in each one.
kit.data.exportHint: Everything you have in {app}, in a .zip you can keep or take to another installation. Your password, sessions and tokens are not in it.

kit.modules.title: Modules
kit.modules.one: With only one on, the app opens straight in it. With two or more, you move between them by tapping the icon at the top of the menu, or from the column at the side on a computer.
kit.modules.off: A module turned off keeps your data: it only leaves your menus.
kit.modules.order: Drag each module by its handle, or tap the handle, to change the order they show in on the bar.
kit.modules.installWeb: Install {host}, or each module on its own, on your device:
kit.modules.installApp: If you prefer, you can install the modules on their own:
kit.modules.installPickClick: Click the one you want to install: it opens in a new tab.
kit.modules.installPickTap: Tap the one you want to install: it opens in a new tab.
kit.modules.installPickApp: Tap the module you want: it opens in the browser. If it asks you to sign in, use your usual account.
kit.modules.installIos: Tap Share (the square with the arrow pointing up), then “Add to Home Screen”.
kit.modules.installAndroid: Open the browser’s menu (⋮) and tap “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.
kit.modules.installMacSafari: In the File menu, choose “Add to Dock”.
kit.modules.installFirefox: Firefox doesn’t install apps on a computer: open the page in Chrome, Edge or Safari and install it from there.
kit.modules.installDesktop: Click the install button in the address bar or, in the browser’s menu, the option to install the page as an app.
kit.modules.installOffline: Done: it opens like any other app and keeps on the device what you have already seen, so you can look at it without a connection and keep working: your changes are sent when the connection is back.
